name: spindrift

scripts.test:chart-pins: bun test test/conformance/second-target-admission.test.ts -t "each chart consumer pins the version its Chart.yaml carries"

//dependencies: What the *server* imports at runtime, and nothing else. The UI's libraries are build inputs: they are compiled into dist/ and the shipped image never resolves them, so they sit in devDependencies and `bun install --production` leaves them out. test/web/routes.test.ts asserts the server's module graph agrees.
//vercel: `vercel` is not imported — it is the CLI the Vercel deploy adapter spawns (`bunx vercel deploy --prebuilt`) to deploy a Build Output tree, so it is a runtime dependency `bun install --production` keeps rather than a build-only one. It stays out of the server module graph the note above describes.
